source.operation: offline response parsing, STATUS? bit decoding, and read-only query construction
source.transport: FTDI FT232R USB serial port /dev/ttyUSB0 at 9600 8N1, no flow control; saved response bytes for every test

manual.title: GPD-X303S Series User Manual
manual.location: REMOTE CONTROL chapter, PDF pp. 43-52; local copy ref/gwinstek/GPD-X303S_User_Manual_82PD-433S0MC1.pdf

data.raw_provenance: Real VOUT1? response captured on 2026-11-19 from GPD-4303S serial EP924162, firmware V2.08, at 9600 8N1 while the output was energised; recorded in artifacts/manuals/ground-truth.md. The reading is uncalibrated read-back, not a calibration certificate.

support.hardware_verified_scope: Response parsing and read-only query framing only: *IDN?, STATUS?, HELP?, and VSET<X>?, ISET<X>?, VOUT<X>?, IOUT<X>? on CH1-CH4, on GPD-4303S serial EP924162, firmware V2.08, /dev/ttyUSB0 at 9600 8N1, captured 2026-11-19. The same unit was re-queried later the same day (verify_all, 11:38:50Z); that evidence directory is git-ignored and is a local reference only. CH3/CH4 have preserved raw bytes, including captures/006-VSET3.raw through 013-IOUT4.raw; CH1/CH2 VSET/ISET responses remain transcript-recorded. The HELP? response is indexed in captures.jsonl with capture_method console-transcript (reconstructed from the session transcript).
known_limitations: No write command was exercised: OUT<Boolean>, VSET/ISET set forms, TRACK<NR1>, SAV/RCL, BAUD, LOCAL, and REMOTE remain documented only.

The transmission order of the eight STATUS? characters is not documented by the manual; the decode defaults to lsb-first and reports the msb-first alternative next to it. The lsb-first default is corroborated, not proven, by the 00110010 capture: baud_9600_matches_link and output_off_matches_vout_zero.
The lsb-first tracking decode (11 -> series) has not been confirmed on the panel; when STATUS? reports series or parallel tracking, CH1/CH2 independence is unproven.
OUT1 is idempotent and OUT1? does not exist on the verified unit; OUT0 is the only observed way to turn the output off. This is probe-derived experience, not a manual statement.
ERR? is documented (manual pp. 47, 52) but was not exercised and is not sent by this Skill.
Only Invalid Character. was observed on the wire; the other five documented error messages are untested on this firmware.
VOUT and IOUT are separate queries, so a voltage and its current are not simultaneous samples.
USB descriptor 0403:6001 and the /dev/ttyUSB0 node are host-side evidence, not manual text.
The read-only query forms were observed in two sessions on 2026-11-19; the output-on readings remain a single observation because re-energising the output is out of scope.

evidence.reason: no write command was sent during the verified session
the manual defines the STATUS? bit meanings but not their transmission order
